m_TextContent:
Dear Holey & Moley,

Good tidings, mole brethren! I'm holding the grandest of parties at the town
square, but this party is no ordinary one! 'Tis is a party only for the most
deserving, the most dapper, the most party-centric of mole society!

Should you accept the invitation, there are standards to be met.

3) Entertainment! The grandest party is incomplete without music, bring something
entertaining for everyone!

1) There are holes in walls scattered around the land, only by fitting through
them precisely, will you get closer to the party itself.

Ready to have the grandest time of your lives? Then see you there!

Yours Sincerely,
Nolan the Golden

2) I expect fashion of the highest calibre. We have a fiesta theme going so
stick to it!
